title: trace.x_origin request

render_time_unit.description: Controls only canonical response time rendering: auto, ps, ns, or us. It never changes input parsing, sampling, filtering, or ordering.

signal.description: Final leaf signal path. Aggregate, array, and struct roots are not expanded automatically.

time.description: Target sample time. Prefer a canonical string with a unit; a bare number is interpreted as nanoseconds.

value_format.description: 返回 LogicValue 的显示格式；不改变比较、采样或底层四态值。

max_nodes.description: Maximum X-origin nodes analyzed across all branches.

max_time_steps.description: Maximum distinct waveform times visited across X-origin branches.

max_trace_signals.description: Maximum dependency candidates sampled at one X-origin step.

timeout_ms.description: Positive public frontend-to-engine request timeout in milliseconds. Omit limits.timeout_ms to disable the public watchdog.

description: Trace an X value backward through effective semantic DFS branches to its sources or observability boundaries.
x-description-zh: 从指定信号和时间按有效语义 DFS 多分支追溯 X 的产生位置或不可见边界。
x-purpose: 从指定 signal/time 追溯 X。
x-how_it_works: 先确认查询值含 X，再按 DFS 同等追踪含 X 的 RHS/control；纯 port/interface/modport/ref alias 路径先归并为一个有效链，再应用 max_chains。query_time 保留请求时刻，逐跳 x_onset_time 表示连续 X 区间起点，active_time 表示 NPI active-driver 时刻。深度停止时以 continue_time 返回可直接续查的 frontier。
x-when_to_use: 返回最终有效 X 链，找到一个或多个 X 候选源、不可见边界或受限现场。
x-arg_contract_notes: required: signal, time; optional: value_format; limits: max_depth, max_nodes, max_time_steps, max_trace_signals, max_chains(default 8; after alias coalescing)

use_when: 查询点含 X，需要按 DFS 同时追踪 RHS、control、端口和时间边界；纯 port/interface/modport/ref alias 路径会归并，响应会区分 query_time、x_onset_time 与 active_time。
do_not_use_when: 只需要静态 driver 枚举，或查询点不含 X。

alternatives.when: 只需要指定时刻的单级 active driver。
需要传统单链 active-driver 展开。

constraints: required: signal, time; optional: value_format; limits: max_depth, max_nodes, max_time_steps, max_trace_signals, max_chains(default 8; after alias coalescing)
